description: This file contains unit tests for the TailscaleServeGatewayDiscovery module, specifically testing discovery logic, executable resolution, and environment setup related to Tailscale gateways in a macOS application.

classes.name: TailscaleServeGatewayDiscoveryTests
classes.description: Test suite for TailscaleServeGatewayDiscovery functionalities, including discovery, executable resolution, and environment configuration.

methods.name: discovers serve gateway from tailnet peers
methods.description: Asynchronously tests discovering serve gateway from Tailscale peers based on provided JSON status.

methods.name: returns empty when status unavailable
methods.description: Tests that discovery returns no beacons when Tailscale status is unavailable.

methods.name: resolves bare executable from PATH
methods.description: Checks if the function correctly resolves the path of the 'tailscale' executable in the system PATH.

methods.name: rejects missing executable candidate
methods.description: Verifies that the path resolution function returns nil when executable is not found.

methods.name: adds TERM for GUI-launched tailscale subprocesses
methods.description: Ensures that the environment includes 'TERM'='dumb' for GUI-launched subprocesses.

methods.name: preserves existing TERM when building tailscale subprocess environment
methods.description: Checks that the existing 'TERM' variable is preserved when setting up environment for tailscale subprocess.
